title: Win Gatchalian confident 2027 budget ratified before Dec. 17
summary: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday expressed confidence that the 2027 national budget would be ratified before December 17, as he said reenacting the current budget is not an option given…

blocks.text: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday expressed confidence that the 2027 national budget would be ratified before December 17, as he said reenacting the current budget is not an option given the country's economic situation.

“Kahapon nag-usap kami ni Senator JV [Ejercito] about the schedule at so far naman, based on the target, kakayanin namang maratipikahan ang budget before December 17,” Gatchalian said during an interview on Super Radyo dzBB.

This means the bicameral conference committee has concluded its discussions on the 2027 budget, which will then be transmitted to Malacañang for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s signature, Gatchalian explained.

“Next week, buong week ay budget; the following week, second reading; the following week, third reading and bicam. So kakayanin naman based on our schedule. Hopefully, walang magiging deadlock,” the solon said.

(Next week, the entire week will be devoted to the budget, followed by the second reading the week after, then the third reading and bicameral conference the following week. So, we can manage based on our schedule. Hopefully, there will be no deadlock.)
Gatchalian also said the Senate aims to conclude its plenary debates on the budget by Friday, starting Monday at 1 p.m.

Meanwhile, the lawmaker said the Commission on Appointments (CA) will begin its hearings at 8 a.m. on Monday, as it needs to confirm around 35 presidential appointees before December 17 to avoid their appointments being bypassed when Congress adjourns. —RF, GMA News
